subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should RFC 0009 lock this DSSE trust model and the full snapshot, sharding, query, and delta wire contract as the accepted cross-repository Hosted Feed v1 direction?
rationale: The PR selects permanent compatibility and content-trust behavior while repository policy requires explicit RFC acceptance and active implementations have not supplied synchronized proof.

options.title: Hold draft for interoperability proof
options.body: Keep the RFC open and unmerged until maintainers review redacted producer-consumer proof for the final head and approve the trust boundary.

options.title: Accept the complete v1 contract
options.body: Approve all proposed representations and trust rules, then require accepted metadata and a canonical implementation issue before merge.

options.title: Accept a narrower publisher-first v1
options.body: Defer catalog sharding, generalized queries, or deltas and standardize only the minimum publisher-feed surface already proven end to end.

recommendation.title: Hold draft for interoperability proof
recommendation.body: Keep the RFC open and unmerged until maintainers review redacted producer-consumer proof for the final head and approve the trust boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They co-authored RFC 0009 and are the strongest available repository-member routing candidate for accepting or narrowing its permanent protocol direction.
